thread:
Claire: Quick thread  customer asks for a formal "burst carryover" policy. They want unused burst minutes to roll over between billing windows for launches. Options: 1) full carryover (minutes roll until used), 2) capped carryover (N minutes/month), 3) decay carryover (linear decay over window). Need a sensible GA default + contract tiers.

Dev: Full carryover is simple conceptually but risky for capacity planning (large accumulated balances cause big spikes). Capped carryover feels safest. Decay is elegant but more complex to explain to customers.

Arman: Ops perspective: caps help predict peaks. If we allow large carryovers, we need stricter prewarm and admission controls. Suggest: default cap = 120m/month, with opt-in Enterprise unlimited-but-not-guaranteed. Also add an upper per-burst limit (e.g., 15m) to avoid single-event cliffs.

Liz: Sales feedback: customers love rollover language but hate per-minute billing complexity. Recommend clear examples in pricing: "Standard: up to 60m carryover, Enterprise: up to 240m, Pilot: custom." Also include a one-time waiver for major launches.

Dev: Implementation notes: track tenant carryover balance, enforce per-burst ceiling, expose Console meter "carryover_balance" and a timeline of carryover uses. Decay variant can be an advanced opt-in.

Arman: Runbook: alert when tenant carryover balance > 75% of cap for >30m. Add mitigation play: prewarm, limit concurrent canaries, or ask customer to purchase top-up.

Claire: Decision proposal: GA default = capped carryover 120m/month, per-burst max 15m, decay only as opt-in experimental mode, one-time launch waiver process documented. Owners: Dev -> infra proto, Arman -> runbook/alerts, Liz -> sales FAQ and pricing examples.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-epic "carryover-cap-and-waiver" assigned to @Claire,@Dev,@Arman,@Liz due 2025-04-18

Claire: If no objections by EOD Friday we'll lock defaults and add to Dedicated GA checklist. :thumbsup:
